privacy.en: For a few minutes, the overlay keeps the public name and amount of the Twitch events it is about to show, and the ids of the last alerts, so nothing shows twice. Alerts held during a pause are kept until you resume. Viewer texts that moderation hides or holds are kept (50 at most) until you decide. Uploaded pictures and videos stay on your site. It collects nothing from visitors.
privacy.fr: Quelques minutes, l'overlay garde le pseudo public et le montant des événements Twitch à afficher, et les références des dernières alertes, pour que rien ne s'affiche deux fois. Les alertes retenues en pause sont gardées jusqu'à la reprise. Les textes du public que la modération cache ou retient sont gardés (50 au plus) jusqu'à votre choix. Images et vidéos envoyées restent sur votre site. Il ne collecte rien sur les personnes qui visitent le site.

mcp.name: alert_templates_get
mcp.description: Read how the Twitch alerts of the overlay are written. For each type (follow, sub, resub, gift, cheer, raid, online, offline, hype, redeem) whether it is on, its text template (null = the default sentence), its duration in seconds (null = the module default) and its minimum (bits, gifted subs, viewers or points; null = none), its sound and animation, whether a picture is set (and, when a reaction holds several pictures or videos, how many and the pick rule: random or rotate), the words a template may use (name, count, amount, tier, months, viewers, level, title, text, total, each written between braces in a text), and the state of the queue (paused, held alerts).

mcp.name: voice_moderation_get
mcp.description: Read the voice (text to speech) and moderation settings of the Twitch alerts: whether the voice is on or muted, its voice, language, rate, pitch, volume, maximum length and whether the name is read; what each type shows and reads; the moderation choices (hold the whole alert or only hide the text, links, capital letters, repeats, number of blocked words); and the texts waiting for a decision, with their id, type, name, reason and text. The voice is the browser's: pageReport says whether the overlay page reported support and how many voices it sees.

mcp.name: voice_moderation_update
mcp.description: Change the voice and the basic moderation of the Twitch alerts. Voice: on, voice (name of a voice), language (for example en or fr), rate 0.5 to 2, pitch 0 to 2, volume 0 to 100, maxCharacters 20 to 300, readName. Moderation: holdWholeAlert (true = an alert with a refused text waits for a decision, false = it shows without the text), blockLinks, blockCaps, blockRepeats, blockedWords (list of words, any case or accent). The word list is empty by default. This is basic moderation, not a replacement for Twitch AutoMod. Nothing is sent to the screen.

mcp.name: held_text_decide
mcp.description: Decide on a viewer text that the moderation hid or held: accept (the alert is shown again with its text, and read if the voice is on) or dismiss (the text stays hidden; a held alert then shows without it). Use an id from voice_moderation_get. Nothing is deleted.

mcp.name: alert_template_update
mcp.description: Change one type of Twitch alert. You can switch it on or off (enabled), set its text (text: plain words with the words between braces listed by alert_templates_get; an empty text restores the default sentence), its duration (durationSeconds 2 to 60, 0 = default) its minimum (minimum: bits, gifted subs, viewers or points, 0 = none; only for cheer, gift, raid, redeem), its sound (sound: none, chime, bell, pop, fanfare; heard only if sounds are switched on) or how it enters (animation: default, slide, slideLeft, slideRight, slideTop, slideBottom, fade, jiggle, pop, none). Unknown words in a text are refused with an explanation. Nothing is deleted and nothing is sent to the screen.

mcp.name: reaction_media_upload_begin
mcp.description: Starts adding a video, GIF, picture or sound you made to the media library of the alerts overlay. Give its library name, its exact size in bytes and its sha256. Accepted: webm (VP8/VP9/AV1) or mp4 (H.264, +faststart) up to 25 MB, 30 s and 1920x1080; png, jpeg, webp or gif up to 5 MB; mp3, ogg, wav, m4a or aac up to 10 MB. Returns an upload, a one-time https address to PUT the bytes (curl -T file "address", 8 MB per request), or the number of base64 pieces for reaction_media_upload_chunk. Then call reaction_media_upload_finish. The upload expires after 30 minutes.

name.description: Name in the library, unique, for example "Raid confetti".

bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes.

sha256.description: sha256 of the file, 64 hexadecimal characters.

mcp.name: reaction_media_upload_chunk
mcp.description: Sends one base64 piece of an upload started with reaction_media_upload_begin, when you cannot use the https address. Pieces are 700000 bytes before base64 (split -b 700000), numbered from 0, sent in order; only the last one may be shorter. A piece can be sent again.

data.description: The piece as plain base64 (no data: prefix), 933336 characters at most.

mcp.name: reaction_media_upload_finish
mcp.description: Finishes an upload: the site checks the size, the sha256 and the real content (format, codec, duration, size), then adds the file to the media library, marked as added by the assistant. Returns its name, id, duration, size and, for a video, whether it is transparent (WebM with alpha). Calling it again returns the same file. Use the name in reaction_set, or in a Twitch bot command (onStreamPictures).

poster.description: Optional, for a video: name or id of a picture already in the library that stands for it (a still frame you exported, uploaded first like any picture).

mcp.name: reaction_media_list
mcp.description: Lists the media library of the alerts overlay: name, id, kind (picture, video, sound), size, duration, dimensions and transparency when known, its poster picture, who added it (person or assistant) and which Twitch event reactions use it. Also the built-in sounds.

mcp.name: reaction_media_delete
mcp.description: Deletes a file of the media library (by name or id) and the file itself. Refused while a Twitch event reaction uses it: remove it there first with reaction_set. A Twitch bot command that shows it stops showing it.

mcp.name: reaction_get
mcp.description: Reads the reaction of one Twitch event type on the alerts overlay: whether it is on, its pictures, GIFs and videos (by library name), the order when there are several (random or round_robin), its text, duration, sound and whether a video plays its own sound. For redeem, give reward to read the reaction of one channel point reward; without it, the reaction of all the other rewards and the list of rewards that have their own.

type.description: The Twitch event: follow, sub, resub, gift, cheer, raid, online, offline, hype or redeem.

reward.description: Only with type redeem: one channel point reward, by its Twitch id or the exact title of a reward that already has a reaction here (from reaction_get of redeem, or twitch_events_rewards of Twitch activity). Without it: all the other rewards.

mcp.name: reaction_set
mcp.description: Changes the reaction of one Twitch event type: media (list of library names or ids, pictures, GIFs or videos, 12 at most; an empty list goes back to text only), order (random or round_robin), text (words between braces from reaction_get), durationSeconds (0 = default, else 2 to 60), sound (off, chime, bell, pop, fanfare, or the name of a sound of the library), videoSound (true: the video plays its own sound), enabled. With type redeem and reward, it sets the reaction of that one channel point reward (enabled: whether that reward shows an alert). Only what you give changes. Nothing is shown on screen; use reaction_test.

type.description: The Twitch event: follow, sub, resub, gift, cheer, raid, online, offline, hype or redeem.

media.description: Library names or ids, in order.

order.description: With several files: random (never twice in a row) or round_robin (in turn).

text.description: Sentence shown, for example "Thanks {name} for the follow". Empty: the default sentence.

sound.description: off, chime, bell, pop, fanfare, or a sound name of the library.

videoSound.description: A video plays its own sound.

reward.description: Only with type redeem: one channel point reward, by its Twitch id or the exact title of a reward that already has a reaction here (from reaction_get of redeem, or twitch_events_rewards of Twitch activity). Without it: all the other rewards.

mcp.name: reaction_test
mcp.description: Sends one TEST alert of this Twitch event type to the alerts overlay pages open now (OBS or a browser), with a sample name, exactly as a real event would look. With type redeem and reward, the test shows that reward's reaction. It waits its turn in the queue. Nothing reaches Twitch.

type.description: The Twitch event: follow, sub, resub, gift, cheer, raid, online, offline, hype or redeem.

reward.description: Only with type redeem: one channel point reward, by its Twitch id or the exact title of a reward that already has a reaction here (from reaction_get of redeem, or twitch_events_rewards of Twitch activity). Without it: all the other rewards.

mcp.name: composition_places
mcp.description: List where text can be placed on alert media: one place per Twitch event type (event:follow, event:sub…) and one per channel point reward that has its own reaction (event:redeem:<reward id>), with its files (address, kind picture/gif/video, width, height, durationSeconds, transparent, poster, hasComposition) and the automatic values its texts may use ({name}, {amount}…). Start here.

mcp.name: composition_get
mcp.description: Read the composition (text placed on a file) of one file of one place, or a starting point when there is none, with its texts filled with examples. A composition: v 1, format, backdrop (src, fit, focus, play, sound), duration, 1 to 4 boxes (x, y, w, h in percent of the frame, size in px of a 1080-high frame, look, outline, in/out animations).

place.description: A place from composition_places, e.g. "event:sub" or "event:redeem:<reward id>".

src.description: The file's address from composition_places, e.g. "/uploads/….webm".

reward.description: Only with the place "event:redeem": one channel point reward (Twitch id or exact title) that has its own reaction.

mcp.name: composition_set
mcp.description: Save the text placed on one file of one place. composition is a JSON text. Every problem is listed at once, in plain words, and nothing is saved then. dryRun: true checks and completes it (still picture and length of a video) without saving. Look at composition_preview before saving. Off until the owner grants it.

place.description: A place from composition_places, e.g. "event:sub" or "event:redeem:<reward id>".

src.description: The file's address from composition_places, e.g. "/uploads/….webm".

composition.description: The composition as a JSON text (one object, v: 1). Start from composition_get.

reward.description: Only with the place "event:redeem": one channel point reward (Twitch id or exact title) that has its own reaction.

mcp.name: composition_preview
mcp.description: Return an approximate PICTURE of a composition, drawn by the site (server font, still frame of a video), with per box the size reached, the lines, an overflow flag and the contrast. Either the saved one (place, src) or one you send (composition, not saved). 20 a minute. LOOK at it, adjust, try again.

place.description: A place from composition_places, e.g. "event:sub" or "event:redeem:<reward id>".

src.description: The file's address from composition_places, e.g. "/uploads/….webm".

composition.description: The composition as a JSON text (one object, v: 1). Start from composition_get.

at.description: The moment shown, in seconds (default: once every text is in).

sample.description: long: very long name and huge amounts, to see shrinking and cutting.

width.description: Width of the picture in px (default 960; 1280 for the kit).

background.description: What shows through transparent parts (default checker).

reward.description: Only with the place "event:redeem": one channel point reward (Twitch id or exact title) that has its own reaction.

mcp.name: composition_render_kit
mcp.description: Return a self-contained HTML page that draws the composition exactly as OBS does (same engine), to open in YOUR OWN headless browser: it reads the files from this site, plays the video, and #t=2.5 in the address freezes a moment. Use it when the approximate picture is not enough.

place.description: A place from composition_places, e.g. "event:sub" or "event:redeem:<reward id>".

src.description: The file's address from composition_places, e.g. "/uploads/….webm".

composition.description: The composition as a JSON text (one object, v: 1). Start from composition_get.

sample.description: long: very long name and huge amounts, to see shrinking and cutting.

width.description: Width of the picture in px (default 960; 1280 for the kit).

background.description: What shows through transparent parts (default checker).

reward.description: Only with the place "event:redeem": one channel point reward (Twitch id or exact title) that has its own reaction.

mcp.name: composition_copy
mcp.description: Copy the text boxes of one placement onto another file (same place or another): the target keeps its own backdrop; between videos the playback goes along. Off until the owner grants it.

fromSrc.description: The file's address from composition_places, e.g. "/uploads/….webm".

toSrc.description: The file's address from composition_places, e.g. "/uploads/….webm".

fromReward.description: Only with the place "event:redeem": one channel point reward (Twitch id or exact title) that has its own reaction.

toReward.description: Only with the place "event:redeem": one channel point reward (Twitch id or exact title) that has its own reaction.

mcp.name: composition_remove
mcp.description: Remove the text placed on one file of one place: the file then shows alone, as before. The file stays on the reaction. Never granted by default.

reward.description: Only with the place "event:redeem": one channel point reward (Twitch id or exact title) that has its own reaction.

fr.mcp.alert_templates_get: Lit les textes, durées et minimums des alertes Twitch de l'overlay, et l'état de la file.
fr.mcp.alert_template_update: Change un type d'alerte Twitch : allumé ou éteint, texte, durée ou minimum. Ne supprime rien.
fr.mcp.voice_moderation_get: Lit la voix et la modération basique des alertes Twitch, et les textes en attente de décision.
fr.mcp.voice_moderation_update: Change la voix (lecture à voix haute) et la modération basique des alertes Twitch. N'envoie rien à l'écran.
fr.mcp.held_text_decide: Accepte ou écarte un texte du public que la modération a caché ou retenu. Ne supprime rien.
fr.mcp.reaction_media_upload_begin: Commence l'ajout d'une vidéo, d'un GIF, d'une image ou d'un son que vous avez créé à la bibliothèque de l'overlay d'alertes.
fr.mcp.reaction_media_upload_chunk: Envoie un morceau en base64 d'un ajout commencé, quand l'adresse https n'est pas utilisable.
fr.mcp.reaction_media_upload_finish: Termine un ajout : le site vérifie le fichier puis le range dans la bibliothèque, marqué comme ajouté par l'assistant.
fr.mcp.reaction_media_list: Liste la bibliothèque de l'overlay d'alertes : genre, taille, durée, qui l'a ajouté et quelles réactions l'utilisent.
fr.mcp.reaction_get: Lit la réaction d'un type d'événement Twitch : fichiers, ordre, texte, durée et son. Pour redeem, reward lit la réaction d'une récompense de points de chaîne.
fr.mcp.reaction_set: Change la réaction d'un type d'événement Twitch : fichiers de la bibliothèque, ordre, texte, durée et son. Pour redeem, reward règle une seule récompense de points de chaîne.
fr.mcp.reaction_test: Envoie une alerte de test de ce type d'événement aux pages d'overlay ouvertes, ou d'une récompense avec reward. Rien n'atteint Twitch.
fr.mcp.reaction_media_delete: Supprime un fichier de la bibliothèque. Refusé tant qu'une réaction l'utilise.
fr.mcp.composition_places: Liste où placer du texte sur les médias des alertes : une place par type d'événement Twitch (event:follow, event:sub…) et une par récompense de points de chaîne qui a sa propre réaction (event:redeem:<id>), avec ses fichiers (adresse, sorte, taille, durée, transparence, image fixe, composition existante) et les valeurs automatiques permises ({name}, {amount}…). Commencez ici.
fr.mcp.composition_get: Lit la composition (le texte placé) d'un fichier d'une place, ou un point de départ s'il n'y en a pas, avec ses textes remplis d'exemples. Une composition : v 1, format, arrière-plan (src, cadrage, point central, lecture, son), durée, 1 à 4 zones (x, y, w, h en pourcentage du cadre, taille en px d'un cadre de 1080 de haut, lisibilité, contour, animations).
fr.mcp.composition_set: Enregistre le texte placé sur un fichier d'une place. composition est un texte JSON. Tous les problèmes sont listés d'un coup, en clair, et rien n'est alors enregistré. dryRun : true vérifie et complète (image fixe et durée d'une vidéo) sans enregistrer. Regardez composition_preview avant. Désactivé tant que la personne ne l'accorde pas.
fr.mcp.composition_preview: Rend une IMAGE approchée d'une composition, dessinée par le site (police du serveur, image fixe d'une vidéo), avec pour chaque zone la taille obtenue, les lignes, le débordement et le contraste. Celle enregistrée (place, src) ou celle envoyée (composition, non enregistrée). 20 par minute. Regardez-la, ajustez, recommencez.
fr.mcp.composition_render_kit: Rend une page HTML autonome qui dessine la composition exactement comme OBS (même moteur), à ouvrir dans VOTRE propre navigateur sans tête : elle lit les fichiers du site, joue la vidéo, et #t=2.5 dans l'adresse fige un instant. Pour quand l'image approchée ne suffit pas.
fr.mcp.composition_copy: Copie les zones de texte d'un placement sur un autre fichier (même place ou autre) : la cible garde son arrière-plan ; entre vidéos, la lecture suit. Désactivé tant que la personne ne l'accorde pas.
fr.mcp.composition_remove: Retire le texte placé sur un fichier d'une place : le fichier s'affiche alors seul, comme avant. Le fichier reste sur la réaction. Jamais accordé par défaut.

label.en: Set the reaction of each Twitch event in one place (Twitch activity)
label.fr: Régler la réaction de chaque événement Twitch à un seul endroit (Activité Twitch)
